title: Developing Action Plan for Urban Wildlife Management with Stronger Focus on Co-existence Measures
what_it_is: Developing Action Plan for Urban Wildlife Management with Stronger Focus on Co-existence Measures

sections.label: NParks public education outreach stakeholders
sections.summary: NParks works with nature groups, academics, agencies and the community in its public education and outreach efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks works with various stakeholders, such as nature groups, academics, agencies and the community in its public education and outreach efforts.

sections.label: NParks wildlife management working groups
sections.summary: NParks works with nature groups on wildlife management, conducts surveys and research, may remove wildlife for public safety, and promotes human-wildlife co-existence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks also works with nature groups as part of various working groups to manage wildlife, including co-creating plans to address issues, such as wildlife rescue, rehabilitation and release.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As part of NParks’ science-based approach to wildlife management, NParks also conducts population surveys and research studies to better understand the distribution of wildlife in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding this, NParks may have to carry out measures, such as the removal of wildlife, to safeguard public safety, where needed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks will continue to work closely with the community to promote harmonious human-wildlife co-existence as part of our efforts to transform Singapore into a City in Nature.

sections.label: NParks poison use pest birds
sections.summary: NParks does not use poison to control pest birds and works with Town Councils to move away from toxins toward humane animal control.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: With regard to the use of poison, specifically, NParks does not use poison in the control of pest birds.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: NParks is also working with the Town Councils to encourage them to move away from the use of toxins and to adopt animal control measures and practices that are humane and safe.
